notes: Narrative roles, not inherently moral foundations.
Devoted matches loyalty; unfaithful also maps to authority vice in dictionary.
Reassuring relates to safety and reducing distress.
Genocidal implies extreme killing, rights violation, and broad moral evil.
White knight implies rescuing/protection; bad boy signals general badness.
Hypochondriac concerns disease; stoic suggests self-discipline.
Yes-man implies compliance; contrarian implies dissent/opposition.
Giving can imply benefitting or helping others.
Flower child is associated with peace/nonviolence.
